title: 第536章 搞事情第535章 掺一脚
lines: 推荐各位书友阅读：长生：别人修仙我练武第一卷：默认第536章搞事情（..la）“决定了，我要在混沌之中突破。”
白小飞心志坚定，已经确定未来要怎么走。
老祖缓缓转过头看向白小飞，道：“想好了？”
数个轮回下来，他就算境界还没突破，真元积攒也已经到了很恐怖的地步。
寻常渡劫期绝不是他对手，已经快要到渡劫无敌的地步了。
当然，他也同样通过基因改造加载了九种体质。
但是重瞳不一样，他不悟大道就无法领悟自身的重瞳合一，毕竟这种体质本身就是跟着这个世界而诞生。
他就只有破妄和造化生机。
当然，世事无绝对，这并不意味着他永远无法重瞳合一。
突破到下一个境界，自身彻底升华后或许会领悟出别样的重瞳合一。
白小飞道：“我想好了，我要沉淀一段岁月继续强化肉身，直到我的肉身能比肩半仙器为止，届时就是我去往混沌突破之时。”
“不错。”
老祖微微点头，算是认可他的想法。
其实这也是一种捷径，但对于此时的白小飞来说已经是最好的办法。
让肉身先超越境界，然后再前往绝地渡过最后一劫提升境界。
好在老祖家大业大，他这个想法完全可以实现。
不灭物质配合他自身气血，不间断一直淬炼肉身，迟早有一天会比肩半仙器。
其实老祖的肉身已经远超能量质量，毕肩他也在一刻不停的练体。
或许，他走进混沌之中也能存活。
但老祖不会去冒险，完全没必要。
仙道消失后，少了一定约束的武道强者又开始如雨后春笋一般冒出。
他们好战，经常打架，但打架亦是进步源泉。
真我境突破方式经过漫长岁月，众生已经将它补全。
转世法有九次轮回机会，突破之法也被一代代查缺补漏变得更完善。
当然，如果没有老祖一直盯着，这些方法都只会小范围流传。
但现在不一样，老祖将它们给整合起来交给苦佛，让它去传递给众生。
大善。
真我境武者数量果然得到质的飞跃，但同时也引起一些新麻烦。
有一个州因为两位真我境武者交手，在苦佛分身阻止之前竟然直接将那个州给打得分崩离析。
这事儿必须认真对待。
苦佛直接召开真我境武者会议，最后以绝对实力压服所有人。
末法时代中期，一百多位真我境武者亲赴灵山，最后定下一条统一规矩。
归真境和真我境的武者绝不允许私自大打出手，就算有纠纷也要交给灵山来裁决。
他们不答应也不行，敢不答应的话，苦佛就把他们度化成和尚。
灵山势大，他们必须低头。
老祖对此事很满意，自觉灵山的建立真是有远见之名，否则这个时候又要他本人来开马甲亲自处理，而且事后还不具备长久性。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Immortality: Others practice immortality while I practice martial arts. Volume 1: Default Chapter 536: Making trouble (..la) "It's decided, I want to break through in the chaos."
Bai Xiaofei is determined and has decided how to go in the future.
The ancestor slowly turned his head to look at Bai Xiaofei and said, "Have you thought about it?"
After several reincarnations, even if he has not yet broken through the realm, his accumulation of true energy has reached a terrifying level.
He is definitely no match for him during the ordinary Tribulation Stage, and he is almost at the point where he is invincible.
Of course, he was also loaded with nine physical constitutions through genetic modification.
But double pupils are different. If he doesn't understand the Great Dao, he won't be able to understand the unity of his own double pupils. After all, this physique itself was born with this world.
He only has the power to destroy delusion and create life.
Of course, there are no absolutes in this world, which does not mean that he will never be able to unite his eyes again.
Breaking through to the next level, you may realize a different kind of unity after you completely sublimate yourself.
Bai Xiaofei said: "I have thought about it. I will settle down for a period of time and continue to strengthen my body until my body can rival a semi-immortal weapon. At that time, it will be the time for me to break through to chaos."
"Not bad."
The ancestor nodded slightly, acknowledging his idea.
In fact, this is also a shortcut, but it is already the best way for Bai Xiaofei at this time.
Let the physical body transcend the realm first, and then go to the Jedi to survive the last tribulation and improve the realm.
Fortunately, the ancestor's family has a great cause, and his idea can be realized.
The immortal substance cooperates with his own energy and blood, and he continues to temper his body. Sooner or later, he will be able to compete with half-immortal weapons.
In fact, the ancestor's physical body has far exceeded the energy quality, and Bi Jian is also practicing his body all the time.
Perhaps he could survive walking into chaos.
But the ancestor will not take risks, there is no need at all.
After the immortal way disappeared, martial arts masters who lacked certain restraints began to spring up again.
They are warlike and often fight, but fighting is also a source of progress.
After a long period of time, sentient beings have completed the method of breaking through the realm of true self.
The method of reincarnation has nine opportunities for reincarnation, and the method of breakthrough has been made perfect by checking and filling in the gaps from generation to generation.
Of course, without the ancestors keeping an eye on them, these methods would only be spread on a small scale.
But it's different now. The ancestor integrated them and gave them to the suffering Buddha to pass them on to all living beings.
Great kindness.
The number of True Self Realm warriors has indeed made a qualitative leap, but it has also caused some new troubles.
In one state, two True Self Realm warriors fought against each other, and before Kufo's clone could stop them, they beat that state to pieces.
This matter must be taken seriously.
Ku Buddha directly convened a meeting of True Self Realm warriors, and finally overwhelmed everyone with his absolute strength.
In the middle of the Age of Ending Law, more than a hundred True Self Realm warriors went to Lingshan in person and finally set a unified rule.
Warriors in the Guizhen Realm and True Self Realm are never allowed to fight privately. Even if there are disputes, they must be left to Lingshan to decide.
It’s okay if they don’t agree. If they dare not agree, Buddha Ku will save them and turn them into monks.
Lingshan is so powerful that they must bow their heads.
The ancestor was very satisfied with this matter and felt that the establishment of Lingshan was really far-sighted. Otherwise, he would have to come and handle it personally at this time, and it would not be sustainable afterwards.
